reason: Same claim as E-20260930-01: keeping the old value valid for its period versus excluding it once superseded, scored on as-of-date and current-value probes, is the hide-versus-retain contrast that spec runs. Its revision E-20260930-01-r2 (written today) adds this card's correction-versus-world-change labels to the 30 PDLC episodes and reports per-kind rows. A typed change arm is not built because the KIP note is a specification with no accuracy numbers.
